evidence.required: Use approved stable body + strict decode + exact Scope003/adoption fresh helper. Retain validated raw buffers with their pins. Renew strict >60 reserve immediately before exclusive write, check full write/fsync and readback exact original serialized bytes.
evidence.source: Scope freshness sampled once before scanning; no fixed Source003/adoption validation, interval-start/header guards or renewed reserve immediately before output open. load decodes one read then pin rereads. Output ignores returned write count, fsync and expected whole serialized readback.

evidence.required: Validate exact six output key/path roster per scoped ordinal and current ordinary actual claim bytes; claim.scope equals retained scope fact3, supervisor.scope and supervisor.claim agree, supervisor Source pin consistent. Construct permitted member paths only from those validated consumed runs, include matching optional prelaunch/parent/actual return files, and refuse or explicitly leave unrelated eligible orphans direct rather than label them consumed. Missing files must remain absent.
evidence.source: Claim only exists, its scope/supervisor not read/joined to the scope and supervisor result claim. Outputs only have broad parent.parent domain. The member sweep includes every eligible C file without binding each attempt/prelaunch/witness to validated consumed ordinal(s); an orphan eligible file would be labeled selected consumed evidence.

evidence.required: Require exact builtin EOF dictionary {stdout,stderr}, each value literal True. Use lexists for physical missing-file classification and ordinary path guards on every present record; never report a dangling/reparse identity as uncreated.
evidence.source: all(result['actual_stream_EOF'].values()) accepts empty dict or truthy non-bools. Path.exists() can classify a dangling link as not-created.
